channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Iran says three ships catch fire after hitting Hormuz mines
item.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say three oil tankers have caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Drone attack on Colombia police base injures civilians, including infant
item.description: Far-right President De la Espriella steps up offensive as rebel groups strike back with drone strikes, roadside bombs.

item.title: US escalates sanctions on Iran, targets ‘shadow banking’ networks
item.description: US Treasury sanctions over two dozen Iranian entities, citing efforts to disrupt Tehran's global financial activities.

item.title: Iran flogs singer Parastoo Ahmadi for performing without headscarf
item.description: Ahmadi and four production team members also face two-year bans on travel and artistic activity.

item.title: Iran hits US bases and civilian sites in the Gulf after a lull
item.description: Tehran has ramped up attacks in recent days as the US naval blockade and sanctions campaign hurt the country.

item.title: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say
item.description: Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were reportedly given 74 lashes in Qom.

item.title: Israeli attacks have turned Gaza into 'toxic wasteland', Oxfam says
item.description: The report says there are signs of possible contamination across almost all of Gaza as a result of Israel's actions.

item.title: Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory
item.description: At least three people were killed and many more feared dead after a fire at a confectionary factory.
